# Faceless Video Kit

> A web app that makes faceless YouTube videos, long-form first, plus Shorts. You set up a channel once, pick a topic, see the title and thumbnail first, approve the script, and get the finished video: an MP4, the thumbnail, the title, description and tags, and a Final Cut / Resolve timeline. Nothing to install and no AI accounts of your own.

- Who it's for: people who want a faceless YouTube channel without a camera, a mic or editing.
- How it works: sign in with Whop at app.facelessvideokit.com. Each video shows the most credits it can use before it starts; you pay what it actually used and the rest stays in your wallet. Close the tab and it keeps going; you're emailed when it's ready or needs your yes.
- Looks: 12, including realistic documentary, history, 3D animated, anime, flat explainer, whiteboard, stick figure and watercolour. Drawn pictures, stock footage, animated explainers or AI video clips.
- Price: Starter $29/month (2,000 credits), Creator $59/month (5,000), Studio $129/month (12,000). Top-ups from $10 (500 credits). Optional Niche Pack ($19) or Launch Bundle ($29) with the first month.
- Refund: in full within 7 days of paying, as long as no video has been started.
- Earnings: not promised. Results depend on niche, posting and YouTube's rules.
